slides.headline: He was sent back to Kerala at age 4 for school. He just won a global award named after a US President.
Sunny Varkey won the 2026 Eisenhower Global Transformation Award at a New York gala on November 9, 2026.
slides.body: Born in Ranni, Kerala, Varkey's family moved to Dubai when he was very young, but he was sent back to Kerala around age 4 for schooling at a Catholic boarding school, returning to Dubai around 1970.

slides.headline: He built the world's largest network of private K-12 schools - and a $1 million prize for teachers.
slides.body: Varkey founded GEMS Education, now the largest private K-12 school operator globally, and the Varkey Foundation, which created the Global Teacher Prize - the world's largest teaching award.

slides.eyebrow: Why it matters for Viksit Bharat 2047
slides.headline: A Viksit Bharat benefits when a Kerala schoolboy's education becomes the foundation for a global push to value teachers everywhere.
slides.body: Varkey's path - sent home to Kerala for his own schooling, now funding recognition for teachers worldwide - is a reminder that investment in education compounds far beyond where it starts.
